items.note: Yellow band hero with regular-weight display title, centered lead and a single pink CTA; a pink coin, star, tag and speech-bubble sticker sit tilted and cropped at the band edges clear of the text, a pill tag-wall strip runs under it, then an outlined featured card with a yellow sticker panel and a 3-column grid of outlined post cards with pill tags.

Band collapses to title, lead and pink CTA with the four stickers rendered static in a row below the button (nothing over the CTA, fixing the rc.5 drift overlap), the pill strip scrolls sideways, and cards stack one per row with an ink Subscribe button so only the hero CTA is pink.

Same layout on a black ground with dark raised cards, paper current-page pill and a paper Subscribe; the hero coin and star keep pink, but the tag, speech-bubble and featured-card document stickers, white in light, become dark-gray blobs whose ink glyphs barely show on the yellow.

Dark ground, yellow band with static sticker row and pink CTA, stacked dark cards; the white-filled stickers in the row and on the featured card turn dark gray, so they read as silhouettes rather than the bright sticker art of the reference's dark hero.

Yellow section band with breadcrumb, 3xl regular title, meta and pill tags over an ink rule; a left 'On this page' list beside a ~60ch article column with an outlined pull quote, outlined code box, one sticker figure on yellow, related-post cards and the pink Subscribe as the page's only pink action.

Band holds breadcrumb, 2xl title and tags; the table of contents becomes a horizontal pill strip, the figure scales down inside the column, the code block scrolls inside its box, and related cards stack, with no sideways page scroll.

Yellow band keeps ink text with dark-filled tag pills, body text is light on black and the pull quote and code box are dark raised boxes; the inventory figure's white card and button shapes turn dark gray on the yellow panel.

Collapsed yellow band, pill TOC strip, readable light body text, dark quote and code boxes with internal scroll, stacked related cards; the figure is small enough that its dark-filled shapes still read as objects.

Same yellow band treatment as the sibling article (shared section color), TOC column, outlined quote, a template code box and a different sticker figure (two documents with an arrow), then related cards and the newsletter with one pink button.

Band title wraps cleanly over two lines with meta and tags, TOC strip scrolls, code box clips long lines inside its border, numbered checklist and stacked related cards keep an even rhythm down to the pink Subscribe.
Dark article with yellow band and readable body; the two-document figure's white pages become dark-gray sheets on yellow, so the ink text lines inside them nearly disappear.
Collapsed band, TOC strip, dark quote and code boxes, figure scaled down, stacked dark related cards and a single pink Subscribe in the outlined newsletter card.

Teal band with About title and lead over an ink rule, ink current-page pill for About in the header, a 60ch 'Why we write' text block with an underlined link, a small pencil sticker beside 'The authors' heading and three outlined author cards with square initial badges.
Teal band collapses to title and lead, prose and author cards stack one per row with consistent 16px gutters, and the newsletter card ends with the page's single pink Subscribe.
Teal band keeps ink text on black ground, paper current-page pill, dark raised author cards with outlined initial badges and a light pencil sticker, and a pink Subscribe as the one loud action.
Dark stacked layout under a collapsed teal band, author cards evenly spaced, readable secondary text, the pink Subscribe as the only pink action and no overflow at phone width.

findings.summary: In dark mode the stickers' white fills (tag, speech bubble, document and card shapes) switch to the dark raised surface, so on the yellow band they become dark-gray silhouettes with nearly invisible ink glyphs, where the reference's dark hero keeps its sticker art bright.
